tasks.analysis: The unusual properties of spider silk—a remarkable combination of strength and elasticity—have long attracted the attention of many. Spider silk has a breaking point far greater than steel and may stretch its full length before breaking: a 0.01 centimeter thread can support eighty grams. Spider silk is also very durable, a feature well illustrated by the persistence of cobwebs. Throughout history, humans have adapted spider silk for many purposes.
